_doc: The non-canon alternative for every canon (RSW_) creature or plant on a Baroque biome sheet (BIOME_FLORAFAUNA_ART_REVIEW_1: 'the non-canon alternative spelled out as an option').

Each entry is a franchise-free RM_-tier stand-in, spelled out but NOT built: a coined name and a one-line brief of the same game role. The owner picks per row on the biome sheet: keep canon, or use the non-canon alternative (decision field 'noncanon'). Only a pick commissions a def and art.
Where a real RM_/RUT_ stand-in def already exists (census noncanon_twin), the sheet links that row instead and this table is not consulted.

Names: coined per design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/noncanon_beast_names_*.md rules 1-4 (variants keep the stem with a plain modifier); every stem passes src/RimMandrake/Utils/check_pseudo_sw_name.py and shares no 4-letter opening with a coined label in src/. Drafted 2026-11-03, unruled.
